description: This file defines the InstanceAPI class, a REST controller handling POST and GET requests for managing instance-related data such as organization name, country, language, and timezone within an installer module of the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system.

classes.name: InstanceAPI
classes.description: A REST API controller for handling the creation and retrieval of instance settings during installation.

methods.name: handlePost
methods.description: Processes POST requests to save instance data like organization name, country, language, and timezone, with validation and error handling.

methods.name: handleGet
methods.description: Processes GET requests to retrieve stored instance data including organization details, country, language, and timezone.
